title: Galileo Galilei's Life In Reverse, From Arcetri Back to Pisa #Shorts
description:
Galileo Galilei's life runs backwards, from his death at Arcetri in 1642 to his birth in Pisa in 1564. The five steps pass the abjuration of 1633, the Dialogue that caused it in 1632, the telescope he ground in 1609 and the medical course he abandoned as a student. Dates follow the documented record, and later stories are named as disputed.

Made with AI assistance.

#Galileo #Biography #LifeInReverse #Shorts #Astronomy #Renaissance #Documentary

scenes.narration: Three of his fingers are kept under glass in Florence, cut from him in 1737 after a life that ended under house arrest.
Step backwards and he kneels in Rome in 1633 swearing the earth stands still, having published a book that let the moving earth argue its case.
Further back he grinds glass in a Venetian summer in 1609, climbs a bell tower with the tube, and four new stars circle Jupiter by winter.
Before that he leaves Pisa in 1585 without a medical degree, having read geometry in secret while his father planned him for the profession.
At the start there is a boy born in 1564 in Pisa to a lute player who wrote books against the ancient masters of music.
